newEntry.name: Glow & Gather
newEntry.desc: Snip 24 runners, seat four pierced screens and lower a vented lid for a six-part LED-only lantern. Measured sheet/socket reference, customizable windows and calibrated tongues; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL wing grips, connected-card and per-part STL/ZIP. Bottom-seat adhesive required; optional battery LED, never flame.
